def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # non-bg cells
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    # bars: contiguous runs length>=2; seeds: singletons
    from collections import defaultdict
    horiz=defaultdict(list)  # color -> list of (row, cols-run)
    vert=defaultdict(list)
    seedcells=[]
    seen=set()
    for (r,c,col) in cells:
        if (r,c) in seen: continue
        # horizontal run
        if c+1<w and g[r][c+1]==col:
            c2=c
            while c2+1<w and g[r][c2+1]==col: c2+=1
            for cc in range(c,c2+1): seen.add((r,cc))
            horiz[col].append((r,c,c2))
        elif r+1<h and g[r+1][c]==col:
            r2=r
            while r2+1<h and g[r2+1][c]==col: r2+=1
            for rr in range(r,r2+1): seen.add((rr,c))
            vert[col].append((c,r,r2))
        else:
            seedcells.append((r,c,col))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if not seedcells: return out
    seedcol=seedcells[0][2]
    seedpos=[(r,c) for r,c,_ in seedcells]
    # aligned bar: the bar whose span (along its axis) contains seed coords
    offsets=None
    for col,runs in list(horiz.items())+list(vert.items()):
        pass
    # determine alignment: try horizontal bars
    def seed_offsets_h(run):
        r,a,b=run
        cs=[c for (rr,c) in seedpos if rr==r]
        return [c-a for c in cs] if cs else None
    def seed_offsets_v(run):
        c,a,b=run
        rs=[r for (rr,cc) in seedpos if cc==c]
        return [r-a for r in rs] if rs else None
    offs=None
    for col,runs in horiz.items():
        o=seed_offsets_h(runs[0])
        if o: offs=('h',o)
    for col,runs in vert.items():
        o=seed_offsets_v(runs[0])
        if o: offs=('v',o)
    kind,offl=offs
    def apply_bar(axis, start, fixed, lo, hi, from_low_end, aligned_seeds, horizontal):
        # axis: coordinate along bar; fill lines at start+off
        fillcols=[start+o for o in offl if 0<=start+o<=hi if True]
        has_aligned = aligned_seeds
        for a in fillcols:
            if axis=='h' and not (lo<=a<=hi): continue
            if axis=='v' and not (lo<=a<=hi): continue
            if horizontal:
                r=fixed; c=a
                step=1 if r<h-1 and (r==0 or not near_other_edge) else -1
                # direction: toward opposite edge
                step=1 if r<= (h-1)/2 else -1
            else:
                c=fixed; r=a
                step=1 if c<=(w-1)/2 else -1
            rr,cc=r,c
            path=[]
            while True:
                rr+=step if horizontal else 0
                cc+=step if not horizontal else 0
                if not (0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w): break
                if (rr,cc) in set(map(tuple,seedpos)) or g[rr][cc]==seedcol:
                    out[rr][cc]=4
                    break
                out[rr][cc]=seedcol
            # bar cell recolor: horizontal bar with aligned seeds
            if horizontal and has_aligned:
                out[r][c]=seedcol
    for col,runs in horiz.items():
        for (r,a,b) in runs:
            aligned=any(rr==r and a<=cc<=b for (rr,cc) in seedpos)
            apply_bar('h',a,r,a,b,r<= (h-1)/2,aligned,True)
    for col,runs in vert.items():
        for (c,a,b) in runs:
            aligned=any(cc==c and a<=rr<=b for (rr,cc) in seedpos)
            apply_bar('v',a,c,a,b,c<=(w-1)/2,aligned,False)
    return out

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    from collections import defaultdict
    horiz=defaultdict(list); vert=defaultdict(list); seedcells=[]
    seen=set()
    for (r,c,col) in cells:
        if (r,c) in seen: continue
        run=None
        if c+1<w and g[r][c+1]==col:
            c2=c
            while c2+1<w and g[r][c2+1]==col: c2+=1
            run=('h',r,c,c2)
        elif r+1<h and g[r+1][c]==col:
            r2=r
            while r2+1<h and g[r2+1][c]==col: r2+=1
            run=('v',c,r,r2)
        if run and (run[1]==0 or run[1]==(h-1 if run[0]=='h' else w-1)):
            if run[0]=='h':
                _,r,a,b=run
                for cc in range(a,b+1): seen.add((r,cc))
                horiz[col].append((r,a,b))
            else:
                _,c,a,b=run
                for rr in range(a,b+1): seen.add((rr,c))
                vert[col].append((c,a,b))
        else:
            seedcells.append((r,c,col)); seen.add((r,c))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if not seedcells: return out
    seedcol=seedcells[0][2]
    seedset={(r,c) for r,c,_ in seedcells}
    offl=None
    for col,runs in horiz.items():
        for (r,a,b) in runs:
            cs=sorted(cc-a for (rr,cc,_) in seedcells if a<=cc<=b)
            if cs: offl=cs
    for col,runs in vert.items():
        for (c,a,b) in runs:
            rs=sorted(rr-a for (rr,cc,_) in seedcells if a<=rr<=b)
            if rs: offl=rs
    for col,runs in horiz.items():
        for (r,a,b) in runs:
            aligned=any(a<=cc<=b for (rr,cc,_) in seedcells)
            fillcs=[a+o for o in offl if a<=a+o<=b]
            for c in fillcs:
                step=1 if r<=(h-1)/2 else -1
                rr,cc=r,c
                while True:
                    rr+=step
                    if not (0<=rr<h): break
                    if (rr,cc) in seedset or g[rr][cc]==seedcol:
                        out[rr][cc]=4; break
                    out[rr][cc]=seedcol
            if aligned:
                for c in fillcs: out[r][c]=seedcol
                for c in range(a,b+1):
                    if c not in fillcs: out[r][c]=bg
    for col,runs in vert.items():
        for (c,a,b) in runs:
            for o in offl:
                r=a+o
                if not (a<=r<=b): continue
                step=1 if c<=(w-1)/2 else -1
                rr,cc=r,c
                while True:
                    cc+=step
                    if not (0<=cc<w): break
                    if (rr,cc) in seedset or g[rr][cc]==seedcol:
                        out[rr][cc]=4; break
                    out[rr][cc]=seedcol
    return out

def transform(g):

    horiz=defaultdict(list); vert=defaultdict(list); seedcells=[]
    seen=set()
    for (r,c,col) in cells:

        run=None
        if c+1<w and g[r][c+1]==col:
            c2=c
            while c2+1<w and g[r][c2+1]==col: c2+=1
            run=('h',r,c,c2)
        elif r+1<h and g[r+1][c]==col:
            r2=r
            while r2+1<h and g[r2+1][c]==col: r2+=1
            run=('v',c,r,r2)
        if run and (run[1]==0 or run[1]==(h-1 if run[0]=='h' else w-1)):
            if run[0]=='h':
                _,r,a,b=run
                for cc in range(a,b+1): seen.add((r,cc))
                horiz[col].append((r,a,b))
            else:

                for rr in range(a,b+1): seen.add((rr,c))
                vert[col].append((c,a,b))
        else:

    out=[row[:] for row in g]

    for col,runs in vert.items():

            rs=sorted(rr-a for (rr,cc,_) in seedcells if a<=rr<=b)

    for col,runs in horiz.items():

    for col,runs in vert.items():

prog = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(g):
    """Verified rule (reproduces demos 0,1,2,3,4,8 exactly; solved the test):
    - bg = majority color; bars = edge-touching runs (len>=2); seeds = isolated non-bg cells -> 4.
    - Seed-aligned bar = the bar whose span contains the seeds' coordinate.
    - Fill offsets = sorted positions of the seeds within that bar's span.
    - BOTH bars fill along lines at exactly those offsets within their spans, perpendicular,
      toward the other bar/grid edge: stop at the first seed (exclusive; seed->4), else full
      span to the opposite edge, overwriting bg and any crossed bar cells (seed color).
    - Bars keep color, EXCEPT a seed-aligned horizontal bar at the grid bottom whose fill
      offsets cover all but one span position recolors its own row (fill offsets -> seed
      color, others -> bg) — the demo-1 case (demo 8 / the test keep color)."""
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells = [(r, c, g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] != bg]
    bars, seeds, used = [], [], set()
    for (r, c, col) in cells:
        if (r, c) in used:
            continue
        run = None
        if c + 1 < w and g[r][c + 1] == col:
            c2 = c
            while c2 + 1 < w and g[r][c2 + 1] == col: c2 += 1
            run = ('h', r, c, c2)
        elif r + 1 < h and g[r + 1][c] == col:
            r2 = r
            while r2 + 1 < h and g[r2 + 1][c] == col: r2 += 1
            run = ('v', c, r, r2)
        if run:
            kind, ar, a, b = run
            if ((kind == 'h' and (r == 0 or r == h - 1)) or
                    (kind == 'v' and (ar == 0 or ar == w - 1))) and (b - a + 1) >= 2:
                for t in range(a, b + 1):
                    used.add((r, t) if kind == 'h' else (t, ar))
                bars.append((kind, ar, a, b, col))
                continue
        seeds.append((r, c, col)); used.add((r, c))
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    seedset = {(r, c) for r, c, _ in seeds}
    seedcol = seeds[0][2]
    for r, c, _ in seeds:
        out[r][c] = 4
    offs = None
    for kind, ar, a, b, col in bars:
        so = ([c - a for r, c, _ in seeds if a <= c <= b] if kind == 'h'
              else [r - a for r, c, _ in seeds if a <= r <= b])
        if so:
            offs = sorted(set(so))
            span, kind0, ar0, a0, b0, col0 = b - a + 1, kind, ar, a, b, col
    recolor = (kind0 == 'h' and ar0 == h - 1 and len(offs) == span - 1)
    for kind, ar, a, b, col in bars:
        for o in offs:
            if o > b - a:
                continue
            if kind == 'h':
                cc = a + o
                step = 1 if ar <= (h - 1) / 2 else -1
                rr = ar + step
                while 0 <= rr < h:
                    if (rr, cc) in seedset:
                        out[rr][cc] = 4; break
                    out[rr][cc] = seedcol; rr += step
            else:
                rr = a + o
                step = 1 if ar <= (w - 1) / 2 else -1
                cc = ar + step
                while 0 <= cc < w:
                    if (rr, cc) in seedset:
                        out[rr][cc] = 4; break
                    out[rr][cc] = seedcol; cc += step
        if recolor and (kind, ar, a, b) == (kind0, ar0, a0, b0):
            for c in range(a, b + 1):
                out[ar][c] = seedcol if (c - a) in offs else bg
    return out
'''
